# Harbor Tea brand guidelines

Harbor Tea is a tea shop and online store. The name is always "Harbor Tea" (never HT).

## Voice
Calm, precise, friendly. Sentence case everywhere. Never use exclamation marks.

## Colors
- Harbor Blue #0B3954 (primary, type and dark grounds)
- Leaf #87BBA2 (accent)
- Cream #FAF3E3 (light grounds)
Use Harbor Blue text on Cream or Leaf. Never put Leaf text on Cream.

## Type
Headlines in Playfair Display Bold. Text in Source Sans 3 Regular.

## Logo
Use the blue logo on light grounds and the cream logo on Harbor Blue. Place it bottom-right. Never stretch or recolor it.

## Claims
We may say "Loose-leaf tea, packed the week it ships." We must never say "organic" (we are not certified) or "cures", "detox" or any health claim.
